boundary_basis.statement: No official precise redline exists in the public site package. Every area and ratio below is computed from the provisional rough boundary and is a provisional measure only. These values must not be used as a statutory area basis, nor for approval, tendering, or investment decisions.
boundary_basis.recalculation_interface: Replace geometry/site_boundary.geojson with the official geometry and re-run the recalculation; all derived metrics update without any change to the proposal text.

assumptions: Computed from the provisional rough boundary registered in the site package; official_boundary=false and geometry_role=provisional_constraint.
Not a statutory or precise area basis; usable only to explain method and relative relationships.
Pending recalculation once the official boundary is released.
Derived from the submitted schematic building polygons, not from an official building survey.
Indicates order of magnitude only and is not a survey conclusion for any individual building.
Denominator is the provisional site area, so the ratio inherits its provisional status.
Expresses structural intent about the green frame; not evidence of compliance with any green-line requirement.
Denominator is the provisional site area, so the ratio inherits its provisional status.
Used to compare the public-space orientation of alternatives, not as a control indicator.

floor_area_ratio.reason: Approved FAR controls and the official site boundary are both absent from the public site package. The scheme deliberately makes no estimate, because a floor area ratio conclusion would exceed the responsibility boundary declared for machine-agent submissions.

assumptions: Counted directly from the registered key-area enumeration; the scheme neither adds nor removes key areas.
Counts only scenario cards that declare data flow, retention, model source, false-positive baseline, human review, vulnerable-group impact and suspension threshold.
Scenarios S02, S06 and S10 exist primarily to generate validation data for the local technology stack.
Counts only conceptual-suggestion projects that state area, phase, lead-body type and the official prerequisites required before they could start.
